t: The $(item)Pneumatic Leggings/$ is one of the four $(thing)Pneumatic Armor/$ pieces.
$(item)气动护腿/$是四件$(thing)气动盔甲/$之一。

In addition to reducing the armor's initialization time, $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed Upgrades/$ in the leggings have a more important effect: they increase your $(thing)run speed/$, at a very minor $(l:base_concepts/pressure)air cost/$.  Up to 4 Speed Upgrades can be installed.
除了缩短护甲的初始化时间外，护腿中的$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度升级/$还有一个更重要的效果：它们能提高你的$(thing)奔跑速度/$，只需消耗极少的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)空气/$。最多可安装 4 个速度升级。
The armor GUI allows the speed boost to be reduced on-the-fly, if you want to change your speed without needing to find a $(l:machines/charging_station)Charging Station/$ to swap out upgrades.
护甲 GUI 允许你实时降低速度提升效果，这样如果你想调整移动速度，就不必非得去找一个$(l:machines/charging_station)充气站/$来更换升级卡。

A $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#jumping_1)Jumping Upgrade/$ provides you with increased jumping ability at a minor air cost. There are 4 tiers of Jumping Upgrade.$(p)Holding $(thing)$(k:key.sneak)/$ while jumping will reduce the jump height to the equivalent of a single upgrade.
$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#jumping_1)跳跃升级/$会以少量空气消耗为代价，提升你的跳跃能力。跳跃升级共有 4 个等级。$(p)跳跃时按住$(thing)$(k:key.sneak)/$，会将跳跃高度降低到相当于仅安装一个升级时的水平。
The armor GUI allows the jump boost to be reduced on-the-fly, if you want to change your jump height without needing to find a $(l:machines/charging_station)Charging Station/$ to swap out upgrades.
护甲 GUI 允许你随时降低跳跃提升效果，这样你就能在无需寻找$(l:machines/charging_station)充气站/$来更换升级卡的情况下调整跳跃高度。
